title: Noise and Proofreading
transcript:
You've got two rooms in your plan. How will you know whether noise explains any difference in the scores?
I could use the same room for everyone and play recorded chatter through a speaker in half the sessions.
That would keep the lighting and furniture constant. What will you ask the participants to do?
I've written a proofreading task. They get a short passage and mark any errors they find.
You'll need a clear stopping point. People who carry on longer have more chances to spot errors.
I'll give them six minutes. I tested that yesterday, and nobody reached the end of the passage.
What did the volunteers say about the recording afterwards?
A few said they kept listening because they could follow the conversation. The voices were unusually clear.
Try a recording with several overlapping conversations, then. That's closer to the background sound you described in your proposal.

questions.prompt: Half the sessions will include recorded ____ played through a speaker.
questions.explanation: 学生打算在一半的实验场次中通过扬声器播放录好的闲聊声。

questions.prompt: Participants will complete a ____ task that involves marking errors.
questions.explanation: 学生设计了校对任务，让参与者标出短文中的错误。

questions.prompt: The student will allow ____ for each participant to work on the passage.
questions.explanation: 学生决定给每人六分钟，试做时无人能在这段时间内读完整篇短文。

questions.prompt: Why did some volunteers keep listening to the sound?
options: They could understand what was being said.
They recognised one of the speakers.
questions.answer: They could understand what was being said.
questions.explanation: 几位志愿者说谈话内容听得清楚，所以他们一直留意那段声音。

questions.prompt: What change does the tutor suggest making to the recording?
options: Use several conversations that can be heard at the same time.
Insert regular pauses between the voices.
Move the voices further away during the recording.
questions.answer: Use several conversations that can be heard at the same time.
questions.explanation: 导师建议改用几段谈话同时响起的录音，以贴近项目所描述的背景声。
